published.source: PR #54 (client 70425: Judgement of Righteousness 42.9%, Champion of the Light 10 / 20 / 30%, Consecration 4.2% a tick; Seal of Righteousness spell power once per the tooltip; Concentration Aura; Human, 2026-10-16)

summary: The twist build retuned for an Undead or Demon boss: Purifying Power 2 for Exorcism and Holy Wrath, cast on cooldown in the twist rotation.
advantage: Exorcism and Holy Wrath only work on Undead and Demons, so against such a boss they're extra damage on top of the usual rotation. This build also takes Purifying Power 2, which makes both cooldowns a third shorter.
advantageShort: Exorcism and Holy Wrath hit only Undead and Demons: extra damage on top of the rotation. Purifying Power 2 cuts both cooldowns by a third.
rotation: Pre-pull: Seal of Righteousness at -3 s, Seal of Command at -1.5 s so the first swing gets the Echo
Consecration on cooldown while mana is at or above 20%
Judgement on cooldown on whichever damage seal is up
Seal of Command whenever no damage seal is up

Twist: with Seal of Command up, swap to Seal of Righteousness in the last 1.5 s before a swing, and back to Command before the next swing (one swap per swing, down to 20% mana); Twist of Light's Echo applies the old seal on the next swing
Racials, Goblin Sapper, Major Mana Potion and Demonic Rune on free GCDs
consumes: Elixir of Greater Firepower (Forever's Holy Power elixir)
caveats: Exorcism and Holy Wrath only land on Undead and Demons, so this build only applies to those bosses

Two synthetic item level 71 trinkets (Forever's launch trinkets aren't simulated): 32 spell power and 18 crit rating, and 140 spell power for 20 s every 2 min, used in the opening seconds and again on cooldown
Twisting is worth 126 DPS, Consecration 109, Holy Strike 99, Hammer of Wrath 29 at 180 s (measured before client 70425)
Human is best since client 70425 (Ruthless, 2% crit with any weapon): about 2 to 3 ahead of Undead (Touch of the Grave) at 180 s
A second crit elixir (Mongoose) would add 14.9 DPS; one 2% crit elixir per character by ruling
Holy Strike's flat part inside the 50% weapon percent comes from client data, not yet confirmed on the beta
High Holy Strike and Consecration ranks may be stale: holding them to their level 30 trend would cost about 1.2%

Seal of Righteousness adds 12% of spell power a hit with a two-hander, once, per the 70425 tooltip (the proc spell itself carries 0): the SoD-style double count (2 x 11%) would be about 46-51 DPS higher, the proc spell's 0 about 53-59 lower
Two-Handed Weapon Specialization applied to Holy seal damage (Era sim choice vs client Physical mask): about -11 if removed
Synthetic gear on the hybrid budget (only the Justice Battlegear 2-piece live)
notes: Request from mksettings with the same arguments as paladin__level_60 except talents and APL, then the target's mobType set to MobTypeUndead, as the class preset's encounter does.
